title: Four degree-50 cyclic components with a merged repetition cell and precision-24 admission

claims.statement: The explicit product of four five-field degree-50 cyclic codes, with its fixed radius-50 adaptive list decoder, carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 29448805838843908281415637498087/50000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=147572113817396230928 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(4019999/60000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all 65 averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), exact child removal counts by noise weight (2), and full cumulative occupancy and error (3). Part zero checks the six-table cube and tight fixed-cap work with 15 organizer-counter replays, and part two checks the retuned true-path weights. The final decoder uses one width-2 repetition cell per field and precision-24 admission; both work and probability witnesses are regenerated.
